## Notes, limitations, tooling

- Mid-wave snapshot: `w1/` and `build/` grow while the wave runs; the frozen inputs
  (`plan.md`, `probe/attest52-probe.mjs` 25162 B, `probe/doctrine52-probe.mjs` 6499 B,
  `base/attest52-base.txt` 675 B, `base/doctrine52-base.txt` 124 B, `base/baseline-gates.txt`)
  are all present and tracked-clean. Recommend a re-run of this audit at close.
- An earlier identical find (same window) agreed on the complete non-`build/` inventory
  (byte order makes every non-`build/` path fall in the visible head/tail of that run);
  this report's listing supersedes it as the authoritative snapshot.
- Tooling directive compliance: **no tools installed or updated** — `find`, `sort`, `git`
  sufficed; no L0 needs recorded. Pacman guard respected (zero pacman calls).
- HEAD at snapshot is `ac5674393f68…`, i.e. the tracked tip has advanced past the plan's
  stated round-open base `02c01258464c…`. Consistent with the three tracked top-level JSONs
  (`w1-spec/taskcall/validate.json`) being committed wave machinery by the L1 after round
  open [INFERENCE on authorship]. Observation only: no tracked file is modified, and no
  seat write is evidenced outside its province.
